products.title: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection - Limited Edition (PlayStation 5)
products.body_html:
Exclusive worldwide PlayStation 5 Limited Edition from Strictly Limited, bringing the cult classic sensation to collectors in its ultimate physical form!

The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal – Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

Enhanced for modern platforms, this definitive edition delivers the ultimate way to experience the full BloodRayne saga — a cult classic series known for its unique blend of action, horror, and gothic style.

Features

  • Complete Trilogy Included – Experience all three games: BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal – Fresh Bites in one definitive collection.

  • Enhanced for Modern Platforms – Updated visuals and performance improvements optimized for today’s systems.

  • Iconic Dhampir Protagonist – Play as Rayne, the half vampire, half human agent of the Brimstone Society.

  • Fast Paced Hack and Slash Combat – Combine acrobatic gunplay, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric powers in stylish action battles.

  • Dark Gothic Storyline – Battle occult forces, supernatural horrors, and vampiric enemies across a globe spanning narrative.

products.title: Tavern Talk Complete Edition - Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure. This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

Inspired by Coffee Talk, VA-11 HALL-A, and classic tabletop RPG adventures, Tavern Talk places you behind the counter of the Wayfarer’s Inn, a lively tavern in the fantasy land of Asteria. As the innkeeper, you will listen to adventurers’ stories, gather rumors, create quests, and serve magical drinks that can influence your patrons’ destinies.

Meet a colorful cast of characters inspired by Pen & Paper adventures, build meaningful relationships, and uncover the mystery of an ancient evil threatening the land. Every conversation, choice, and potion you brew helps shape both the lives of your guests and the future of Asteria itself.

Beyond its heartfelt storytelling and charming atmosphere, Tavern Talk also allows you to customize the Wayfarer’s Inn with trinkets and decorations brought back by returning adventurers, turning your tavern into a true home for weary travelers.

Included DLC Content

The Complete Edition includes previously released additional content on the cartridge.

Pirate Palooza adds stylish pirate-themed outfits for fan-favorite characters Melli and Zephir, perfect for new adventures across the seas of Asteria.

Tempest Tantrum expands the story with roughly three hours of new content, new quests, multiple endings, a brand-new character, additional recipes and ingredients, and a new magical threat unleashed after the events of the main game.

Key Features

  • Cozy fantasy visual novel inspired by tabletop RPG adventures
  • Play as the owner of the Wayfarer’s Inn in the magical world of Asteria
  • Brew magical drinks that influence your patrons’ fates
  • Gather rumors and turn them into quests for adventurers
  • LGBTQ+ positive world and diverse cast of characters
  • Build relationships with a diverse cast of memorable characters
  • Meaningful choices and branching story elements
  • Decorate and personalize your tavern over time
  • Includes all previously released DLC content on cartridge
  • First-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the game
  • Limited physical edition for collectors and fans

Supported Languages

English, German, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean

products.title: Bread & Fred - Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Climb to the summit in Bread & Fred, the charming yet brutally challenging co-op platformer from Atari. Available as an exclusive physical edition, this release lets you experience the complete adventure as two rope-tied penguins whose only chance of reaching the top is perfect teamwork or incredible solo skill.

Meet Bread and Fred, two determined penguins with one ambitious goal: conquer a towering snowy mountain. Tied together by a rope, every jump, swing, and climb requires careful coordination. One mistimed move can send both of you tumbling back down the mountain, turning every successful ascent into a hard-earned victory.

Master the unique physics-based climbing mechanics by using momentum to swing across impossible gaps, anchoring your partner during risky jumps, and grabbing onto walls just long enough to reach the next platform. Whether you're laughing through spectacular failures with a friend or taking on the challenge alone with Jeff the Rock as your trusty climbing partner, every attempt brings you one step closer to the summit.

Once you've mastered the climb, test your skills in Speedrun Mode or dive into the massive Laboratory Update, featuring an entirely new area filled with fresh mechanics, new challenges, and plenty of hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

The mountain is unforgiving, but reaching the top has never been so rewarding.

Key Features

  • Challenging co-op platforming for two players with unique rope-based gameplay
  • Play solo by teaming up with Jeff the Rock
  • Swing, climb, and master precise physics-based movement
  • Conquer a massive snowy mountain packed with challenging obstacles
  • Compete for the fastest times in dedicated Speedrun Mode
  • Includes the complete Laboratory Update with a new map, mechanics, challenges, and hidden secrets
  • Cute penguins, hilarious failures, and endless replayability

products.title: ENDLESS Legend II - Collector's Edition (PlayStation 5)
products.body_html:
Forge your legacy in ENDLESS Legend II, the epic fantasy strategy sequel that brings the acclaimed ENDLESS universe to PlayStation 5 for the very first time. Command unique factions, shape the fate of a dying ocean world, recruit legendary heroes, and build an empire that will stand the test of time. This exclusive physical Collector's Edition is packed with premium collectibles worthy of your conquest.

Collector's Edition

  • Physical Copy of ENDLESS Legend II for PlayStation 5 – Experience the next chapter of the acclaimed strategy series in a premium physical edition.
  • Printed Game Manual – A classic, full-color manual featuring essential gameplay information and artwork inspired by the world of Saiadha.
  • High-Quality Hero Figurine (final design to be announced) – A beautifully crafted collectible statue showcasing one of the game's iconic heroes in a dynamic action pose.
  • Hardcover Lorebook – Discover everything you'd ever like to know about the world of ENDLESS Legend II, including its factions, heroes, lore, artwork, and the rich history of Saiadha.
  • Map Cloth Print of Saiadha – A high-quality art print depicting the ever-changing world of Saiadha, highlighting its regions, oceans, and mysterious landscapes.
  • Original Soundtrack on 2 CDs – Immerse yourself in the atmospheric score of ENDLESS Legend II with a beautifully presented two-disc soundtrack collection.
  • Certificate of Authenticity – A premium numbered certificate commemorating your exclusive Collector's Edition and its place in your collection.

Lead one of six unique factions as you explore, expand, and conquer the mysterious world of Saiadha, a planet slowly being consumed by catastrophic tidal cycles. Every faction offers its own philosophy, strengths, and playstyle, allowing you to forge your own path through diplomacy, exploration, economic growth, or all-out war.

Recruit powerful heroes to lead your armies and govern your cities. As they gain experience, they unlock new abilities, build meaningful relationships, and equip powerful gear that can turn the tide of battle.

The ever-changing world itself is one of your greatest challenges. As massive tidefalls reveal new lands, fresh opportunities and dangerous threats emerge. Adapt your strategies to shifting coastlines, discover hidden resources and ancient anomalies, and seize newly uncovered territory before your rivals do.

With deep 4X strategy, rich world-building, and endlessly varied campaigns, ENDLESS Legend II offers a rewarding experience where no two empires, or playthroughs, are ever the same.

Features

  • Conquer a Living Ocean World – Expand your empire across the dynamic world of Saiadha, where cataclysmic tidefalls constantly reshape the battlefield.
  • Choose Your Faction – Play as one of six distinct factions, each with unique mechanics, philosophies, and strategic approaches.
  • Recruit Legendary Heroes – Develop powerful leaders who grow over time, forge relationships, and command armies with unique abilities.
  • Adapt to a Changing Battlefield – Exploit newly revealed lands, resources, and ancient anomalies as the oceans recede.
  • Build, Expand, and Dominate – Grow thriving cities, manage your empire, research new technologies, and outmaneuver your rivals.
  • Master Deep 4X Strategy – Balance diplomacy, exploration, economy, and warfare in a rich strategic experience.
  • The ENDLESS Universe Comes to Consoles – Experience the next chapter of the acclaimed strategy series on PlayStation 5 for the first time.

products.title: Mr. Nutz (Mega Drive)
products.body_html:
Join the adventurous red squirrel in Mr. Nutz, the beloved 16-bit platformer originally released in the early '90s and now returning in a premium physical limited edition. Compatible with both Genesis and Mega Drive consoles, this release lets retro fans experience one of the era's most charming platforming adventures on original hardware.

Step into the paws of Mr. Nutz as he goes on a colorful journey through whimsical forests, mysterious caves, icy landscapes, and many other imaginative environments. Along the way, you'll battle quirky enemies, uncover hidden secrets, collect valuable items, and overcome challenging platforming sections packed with classic 16-bit charm.

With its vibrant cartoon-inspired visuals, smooth gameplay, and rewarding level design, Mr. Nutz remains a timeless platforming adventure that captures the magic of the golden age of retro gaming. Whether you're revisiting a childhood favorite or discovering it for the first time, there's plenty of fun waiting in every level.

Features:

  • Compatible with both Genesis and Mega Drive consoles
  • Classic 2D platforming with smooth, responsive controls
  • Explore colorful worlds filled with hidden paths and collectibles
  • Battle quirky enemies across a variety of imaginative environments
  • Discover forests, caves, snowy landscapes, and more
  • Charming cartoon-style visuals and memorable soundtrack
  • A beloved retro platforming adventure for collectors and fans alike

products.body_html:
Special Edition Contents

This Special Limited Edition offers additional insights to R-Type III.

Physical Game + Printed Manual (Full Color)

Officially licensed Sony PlayStation 5 game with a reversible cover.
Includes a beautiful retro-inspired printed manual filled with controls, lore, ship systems, Force breakdowns, stage briefs & tips.

Art Booklet

A high-quality soft cover book giving insights to:

  • Concept art to guide the visual journey of the remake

  • Behind-the-scenes designs 

  • Further information on ship with weapons, but also enemies and level designs

  • More insights with comments from developer and some references to early R-Type III marketing from the 90's

Original Soundtrack on CD

  • Newly rearranged orchestration & synth remixes created for R-Type Dimensions III

 

The legendary side-scrolling shoot ’em up returns — bigger, bolder, and far more dangerous than ever before on PlayStation 5.

R-Type Dimensions III is a full-scale reimagining of R-Type III: The Third Lightning, Irem’s cult 1993 console-exclusive masterpiece. Every infamous stage, every grotesque Bydo monstrosity, every cruel trap and rotating biomechanical nightmare has been rebuilt with modern 3D graphics, a rearranged soundtrack, and an arsenal of new features. Yet beneath the new polish beats the same sadistic heart of the SNES classic.

Fans of the original will feel right at home — and completely terrified.

As the pilot of the cutting-edge R-90 “Ragnarok”, you embark on the Third Bydo Mission armed with Wave Cannons, Bits, and one of the most defining mechanics in shmup history: the Force unit. The original R-Type III was the first in the series to introduce multiple Force types (Round, Shadow, and Cyclone), each radically altering how the game is played. These return here in stunning detail, with effects and animations faithful to their 16-bit personalities.

Now, more than 30 years later, you can experience this classic in two completely different dimensions — instantly.

With the push of a button, swap between authentic pixel-perfect 2D visuals and fully reimagined 3D graphics, complete with dynamic lighting, modern effects, animated environments, and cinematic camera flourishes.
No loading. No interruption. Just pure dimensional shift.

For hardcore fans, this remake includes nods to the original SNES secrets, visual homages to Tamtex’s clever Mode 7 trickery, reinterpreted boss-entry animations, and environmental details inspired by Japanese design notes and old developer commentary. (Yes, that infamous Stage 2 censorship oddity? It’s referenced in a clever way. Yes, the lava labyrinth in Stage 4 is still agonizing. No, the Force pod still won’t protect you from everything.)

Prepare to face the Bydo as you’ve never seen them before — or exactly as you remember them.

Either way, you’re going to die. A lot.

New Features in R-Type Dimensions III

Advanced Mode – A New Level of Pain
The entire campaign re-engineered for maximum brutality.

  • Faster enemy movement

  • Denser projectile patterns

  • Remixed waves and boss variants
    It’s the closest thing to a modern arcade “Ultra Mode”

2-Player Local Co-op – Bring a Wingman
Coordinate your Forces, stagger your Wave Cannon charges, and relive the golden age of cooperative shmups — all from your couch.

Instant 2D/3D Switch – Reality Is Optional
Tap once to switch between:

  • Classic SNES-style pixel art, meticulously recreated

  • Dynamic 3D visuals with modern shaders, effects, and animated backgrounds
    Swap on the fly — even mid-boss — for an experience that feels both nostalgic and cutting-edge.

Multiple Difficulty Levels – For Trainees and Masochists Alike
From introductory settings for newcomers to brutal Expert Mode, every pilot can find their (un)comfort zone.

Online Leaderboards – Climb the Dimensional Ladder
Take your place among global R-Type aces.
Score-chasing returns with modern tracking and bragging rights.

Shenmue III – Enhanced Edition for Nintendo Switch 2 delivers the definitive version of Yu Suzuki’s iconic adventure, refined for modern platforms while staying true to its legendary roots. The NSW2 cartridge includes the full game.

This Enhanced Edition elevates the original experience with improved visuals, smoother performance, faster load times, and modern quality-of-life options—all fully optional, ensuring the classic Shenmue feel remains intact for purists while welcoming new players.

A must-have for collectors and fans alike, Shenmue III Enhanced is the definitive way to continue Ryo Hazuki’s unforgettable journey.

Set in a beautifully realized world inspired by rural China, Shenmue III Enhanced delivers a slow-burn, immersive experience centered on exploration, storytelling, and everyday life. As Ryo Hazuki, players investigate mysteries, train in authentic martial arts, interact with fully voiced characters, and uncover secrets at their own pace. Dynamic weather, NPCs with daily routines, and a wealth of optional activities bring the world to life with remarkable authenticity.

  • A Living Open World Adventure
    Explore a detailed, story-driven world with daily NPC routines, mini-games, and immersive side activities.

  • Epic Story by Yu Suzuki
    Continue Ryo Hazuki’s journey in a narrative-focused blend of mystery, exploration, and martial arts.

  • Authentic Martial Arts Gameplay
    Train, learn techniques, and engage in real-time combat that rewards skill and preparation.

  • Enhanced Visuals & Performance
    Sharper textures, smoother gameplay, and faster load times for the best Shenmue III experience yet.

  • Modern Enhancements, Optional by Design
    Quality-of-life improvements, accessibility options, and a classic camera mode — all fully toggleable.

  • The Definitive Shenmue III Experience
    The most refined and accessible version of Shenmue III for both newcomers and longtime fans.
